text:
priya: FYI — scheduled base-image rebuild TOMORROW 03:00 UTC. Need RBAC, KMS, and audit-log checks before cutover. tagging @matt @sasha. short runbook below.

matt: can you drop the exact KMS key policy you'll use? i'll confirm rotation + allowlist. :eyes:

priya: here’s the minimal key binding we plan to apply for the rebuild service account:
```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {"role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter",
     "members": ["serviceAccount:rebuild@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}
  ]
}
```

sasha: runtime note — need to ensure old cached layers / kv caches are cleared before node restart. running a preflight that wipes kvcache and drains one node pool at a time. will post commands. :hammer_and_wrench:

devsec-bot: image-scan completed on staging base -> 2 medium vulns found: openssl (CVE-2024-1234) and busybox (CVE-2024-5678). severity: medium. remediation: rebuild with patched packages.

matt: CVE-2024-1234 fixed in openssl 1.1.1k. busybox needs rebuild to latest stable. plan looks good — prefer package-level bumps rather than switching base distro.

priya: plan — update Dockerfile packages, run layered rebuild, then cosign-sign images with KMS-backed key. rollout window 03:00-05:00 UTC. can someone own post-deploy audit+key-usage verification?

leo: i'll take post-deploy audit + verify KMS usage in logs. sample query i'll run after cutover:
`gcloud logging read "resource.type=crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\"Encrypt\"" --limit 50`

sasha: temporary RBAC tweak needed: allow `rebuild` SA to impersonate `nodepool` SA for the window. terraform snippet we will apply (short):
```hcl
resource "google_project_iam_binding" "rebuild_impersonate" {
  role = "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
  members = ["serviceAccount:rebuild@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```
keep this change timeboxed and documented.

matt: +1 on timebox. add one-hour expiry on the binding if possible and record in ticket INC-3245. also ensure cosign KMS key has disable-raw-export set and rotation policy enabled.

priya: @leo thanks. @devsec-bot can you run another quick scan after the signed images land?

devsec-bot: will run post-signing image-scan and post results here.

sasha: fallback: if anything blocks, abort and rollback to current tag. watch for pod restart latency during node drains. cc @oncall.

priya: :thumbsup: thanks all. i'll push the runbook to /docs/rebuild-runbooks and ping this thread when i flip the switch.
